_format: Patient intents. Each has: class (speech|physical|psychic|intimacy|drift), shown name + icon, an effect block resolved by intents.js. Effects: damage (Composure to player), revealOnRead (fragments revealed if the player correctly handled it), insightToPlayerIfRead, harderHandle (overrides damage if player did not play a handling card), counters (which approach card classes correctly handle this). Voice prose is in voiceprose.json (intents[key].announce / .resolve / .handled).

mutter.name: Mutter
mutter.desc: They speak. Hear it or do not.

tell_a_name.name: Tell a name
tell_a_name.desc: They name someone the file does not know. The name lands like weight.

ask_for_someone.name: Ask for someone
ask_for_someone.desc: They ask the room a question. Answer or take the silence.

say_the_room.name: Say the room
say_the_room.desc: They describe the room they are in. Not this one.

reach.name: Reach across
reach.desc: They reach across the desk for your hand.

smile_wrong.name: Smile wrong
smile_wrong.desc: They smile in a way the muscles do not know.

answer_in_yours.name: Answer in your voice
answer_in_yours.desc: They answer the question you were about to ask. In your voice.

use_your_name.name: Use your name
use_your_name.desc: They say your name. They are not on the staff list.

lash_out.name: Lash out
lash_out.desc: They lunge. The desk is between you. For now.

open_the_wound.name: Open the wound
open_the_wound.desc: They open something that was almost closed.

convulse.name: Convulse
convulse.desc: Their body says no in the wrong language.

stand.name: Stand up
stand.desc: They stand. They were not meant to.

stare.name: Stare past you
stare.desc: Their gaze sets on a spot of wall over your shoulder.

watch_the_corner.name: Watch the corner
watch_the_corner.desc: They will not look at the corner. They are watching it.

breathe_in_time.name: Breathe in time
breathe_in_time.desc: They are breathing in time with something the room is doing.

go_still.name: Go still
go_still.desc: They have stopped moving. The file did not notice when.

drift.name: Drift
drift.desc: They are between things. The file cannot pin them.

refuse_the_room.name: Refuse the room
refuse_the_room.desc: They refuse to be here. The next intent is hidden.

speak_as_other.name: Speak as another
speak_as_other.desc: They speak as if they were the other patient. The one who is not here.

be_more.name: Be more than one
be_more.desc: They are speaking for several. The room shrinks.

closing.name: Close the file
closing.desc: They are closing their own file. !!Make the writing yours, or take what is left.!!
